I already told you that you may only complete this event once.
scripts.translation:
{0}
我已經告訴過你了，這個活動只能完成一次。

scripts.text:
{0}
Please return when you reach BaseLv 60 or higher.
scripts.translation:
{0}
基本等級達到60級後再來吧。

scripts.text:
{0}
Hello, I am the Skill Resetter.
Your name is ^0080FF{1}^000000.
How can I help you?
scripts.translation:
{0}
你好，我是技能重置師。
你的名字是^0080FF{1}^000000。
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text:
{0}
You cannot reset skills
when you keep
any items.
scripts.translation:
{0}
身上攜帶物品時，無法重置技能。

scripts.text:
{0}
Please, drop your cart and we'll continue.
scripts.translation:
{0}
先卸下手推車，才能繼續。

scripts.text:
{0}
Please, free your Falcon and we'll continue.
scripts.translation:
{0}
先放走獵鷹，才能繼續。

scripts.text:
{0}
Please, free your PecoPeco and we'll continue.
scripts.translation:
{0}
先解除大嘴鳥坐騎，才能繼續。

scripts.text:
{0}
Come back soon!
scripts.translation:
{0}
早點回來吧！

scripts.text: ^009500Information about Reset skills.^000000
^00B6FFReset skills.^000000

scripts.translation:
{0}
想重置技能的時候，就來這裡找我！！

scripts.text:
{0}
This skill reset is not FREE OF CHARGE!!
Expense for the reset of skill is ^D5A50020000 Zeny x BaseLv^000000.
Yeah ...each One BaseLv costs 20000 Zeny to reset skill.
scripts.translation:
{0}
重置技能可不是免費的！！
費用是^D5A50020,000 Zeny × 基本等級^000000。
也就是說，基本等級每高一級，就要多付20,000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
{0}
Oh yeah, one more thing!
Any carts, falcons or pecos you have equiped
will be removed if you reset your skills.

scripts.translation:
{0}
重置技能之前，先告訴我你的基本等級。
